name: canon
description: The practice brain. Tenets — how to build, each carrying the incidents that proved it, ratified by the firm — convictions, in their own words, that Count Bassy challenges from and never from its own opinion, and twenty-two standing behaviours for how a session conducts itself, with a docket that hands back what is open and what needs deciding as a form the firm fills in. Mines a corpus and adopts a repository by proposing, never writing. An adversarial pass hands the code to another model to break, and takes back only the tests it wrote. Holds no client data, mirrors no project's code. Ships a tie-out conformance gate a project's builder calls before it publishes: the roster must add up to the document's own headline, the three named sections must be there, and a photographed source must carry a mark -- refusing rather than warning, with no image library to be missing.
